import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pd.set_option('display.width',250); pd.set_option('display.max_rows',300); pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth',60)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def fetch_raw(pid):
    r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=60)
    if r.status_code==200 and not r.text.lstrip().startswith('<'): return 'pdb',r.text
    return 'cif',requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=60).text
def finalize(ch):
    return {c:[{'resi':int(k[0]),'icode':k[1],'resn':v['resn'],'aa':AA3.get(v['resn'],'X'),'atoms':v['atoms']}
               for k,v in sorted(d.items(),key=lambda x:(int(x[0][0]),x[0][1]))] for c,d in ch.items()}
def parse_pdb_text(txt):
    ch={}; het=[]
    for ln in txt.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if not ln.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')): continue
        if ln[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        resn=ln[17:20].strip(); c=ln[21]; resi=ln[22:26].strip(); ic=ln[26]
        name=ln[12:16].strip(); xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
        if resn in AA3:
            d=ch.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault((resi,ic),{'resn':resn,'atoms':{}}); d['atoms'][name]=xyz
        elif resn not in ('HOH','DOD'): het.append((c,resn,resi,name,xyz))
    return finalize(ch),het
def parse_cif_text(txt):
    lines=txt.splitlines(); i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].strip()=='loop_' and i+1<len(lines) and lines[i+1].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols=[]; j=i+1
            while lines[j].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[j].strip().split('.')[1]); j+=1
            idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}; ch={}; het=[]
            while j<len(lines) and not lines[j].strip().startswith(('loop_','#','_')):
                f=lines[j].split()
                if len(f)>=len(cols) and f[idx['pdbx_PDB_model_num']]=='1' and f[idx['label_alt_id']] in ('.','A'):
                    resn=f[idx['label_comp_id']]; c=f[idx['auth_asym_id']]; resi=f[idx['auth_seq_id']]
                    name=(f[idx['auth_atom_id']] if 'auth_atom_id' in idx else f[idx['label_atom_id']]).strip('"')
                    xyz=np.array([float(f[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_z']])])
                    if resn in AA3:
                        d=ch.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault((resi,' '),{'resn':resn,'atoms':{}}); d['atoms'][name]=xyz
                    elif resn not in ('HOH','DOD'): het.append((c,resn,resi,name,xyz))
                j+=1
            return finalize(ch),het
        i+=1
    return {},[]
def get(pid):
    k,t=fetch_raw(pid); return parse_pdb_text(t) if k=='pdb' else parse_cif_text(t)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def nw_fast(S,g=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); F[0,1:]=g*np.arange(1,m+1); F[1:,0]=g*np.arange(1,n+1); jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        G=np.empty(m+1); G[0]=-1e9; G[1:]=np.maximum(F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],F[i-1,1:]+g)
        b=np.empty(m+1); b[0]=F[i,0]; b[1:]=G[1:]-g*jj[1:]
        F[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(b)+g*jj
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i,j-1]+g))<1e-9: j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        else: i-=1
    return pairs[::-1]
def tmalign(Xq,Xt):
    n,m=len(Xq),len(Xt); L=min(n,m); d0=max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
    seeds=[(i,j,Ls) for Ls in [L,L//2,L//4] if Ls>=12
           for i in range(0,n-Ls+1,max(1,Ls//2)) for j in range(0,m-Ls+1,max(1,Ls//2))]
    best=(0,None,None,None)
    for si,sj,Ls in seeds:
        R,t=kabsch(Xq[si:si+Ls],Xt[sj:sj+Ls]); pairs=None
        for it in range(8):
            Xm=Xq@R.T+t; D=np.linalg.norm(Xm[:,None,:]-Xt[None,:,:],axis=2); newp=nw_fast(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if pairs==newp: break
            pairs=newp; cur=np.array(pairs)
            for cut in (d0+4,d0+2,d0):
                Xm=Xq@R.T+t; dd=np.linalg.norm(Xm[cur[:,0]]-Xt[cur[:,1]],axis=1); sel=cur[dd<cut]
                if len(sel)<10: break
                R,t=kabsch(Xq[sel[:,0]],Xt[sel[:,1]])
        if not pairs: continue
        Xm=Xq@R.T+t; ix=np.array(pairs); d=np.linalg.norm(Xm[ix[:,0]]-Xt[ix[:,1]],axis=1)
        tm=float(np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/L)
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,pairs,R,t)
    return best

# side-chain H-bond capability classes
DON={'S','T','Y','N','Q','K','R','W','H','C'}; ACC={'S','T','Y','N','Q','D','E','H'}
CHG={'D':-1,'E':-1,'K':1,'R':1}
REFS={'1EEM':'GSTO1','6GSS':'GSTP1','2C3Q':'GSTT2','1LJR':'GSTT1'}
S={p:get(p) for p in ['7AIA']+list(REFS)}
gd=[r for r in S['7AIA'][0]['AAA'] if 'CA' in r['atoms'] and 23<=r['resi']<=302]
Xg=np.array([r['atoms']['CA'] for r in gd])
GSHN={'GSH','GTX'}
tally=[]; chg=[]; detail=[]
for pid,gene in REFS.items():
    prot,het=S[pid]; cands={}
    for c,resn,resi,name,xyz in het:
        if resn in GSHN: cands.setdefault((c,resi),[]).append((name,xyz))
    key=max(cands,key=lambda k: len(cands[k])); LN=[n for n,_ in cands[key]]; LA=np.array([x for _,x in cands[key]])
    ref=[r for r in prot[key[0]] if 'CA' in r['atoms']]; Xr=np.array([r['atoms']['CA'] for r in ref])
    tm,pairs,R,t=tmalign(Xg,Xr); m={j:i for i,j in pairs}
    nbb=nsc_ok=nsc_lost=nsc_unmapped=0
    for ri,r in enumerate(ref):
        at={k:v for k,v in r['atoms'].items() if k[0] in 'NOSC' and not k.startswith('H')}
        if not at: continue
        nm=list(at); A=np.array([at[k] for k in nm]); D=np.linalg.norm(A[:,None,:]-LA[None,:,:],axis=2)
        if D.min()>4.5: continue
        gi=m.get(ri); g=gd[gi] if gi is not None else None
        dev=float(np.linalg.norm((Xg[gi]@R.T+t)-Xr[ri])) if gi is not None else np.nan
        mapped = gi is not None and dev<5.0
        for a_i,an in enumerate(nm):
            if an[0] not in 'NO': continue
            for b_i,bn in enumerate(LN):
                if bn[0] not in 'NOS' or D[a_i,b_i]>3.5: continue
                bb = an in ('N','O','OXT')
                if bb:
                    cat='backbone_retained' if mapped else 'backbone_unmapped'
                else:
                    if not mapped: cat='sidechain_unmapped'
                    else:
                        don = an[0]=='N' or (an[0]=='O' and r['aa'] in ('S','T','Y'))
                        ok = (g['aa'] in DON) if don else (g['aa'] in ACC)
                        cat='sidechain_retained' if ok else 'sidechain_lost'
                detail.append(dict(ref=pid,gene=gene,ref_res=f"{r['aa']}{r['resi']}",atom=an,lig=bn,
                                   d=round(float(D[a_i,b_i]),2),gdap1=(f"{g['aa']}{g['resi']}" if g is not None else '-'),
                                   ca_dev=round(dev,2) if gi is not None else None,cat=cat))
    # charge of pocket shell: residues with any heavy atom within 8 A of ligand
    sr=sg=0; cov=0; tot=0
    for ri,r in enumerate(ref):
        A=np.array([v for k,v in r['atoms'].items() if not k.startswith('H')])
        if np.linalg.norm(A[:,None,:]-LA[None,:,:],axis=2).min()>8.0: continue
        tot+=1; sr+=CHG.get(r['aa'],0)
        gi=m.get(ri)
        if gi is not None and np.linalg.norm((Xg[gi]@R.T+t)-Xr[ri])<5.0:
            cov+=1; sg+=CHG.get(gd[gi]['aa'],0)
        else: sr-=CHG.get(r['aa'],0); tot-=1   # compare only on mapped positions
    chg.append(dict(ref=pid,gene=gene,TM=round(tm,3),n_pocket_mapped=tot,ref_charge=sr,gdap1_charge=sg,delta=sg-sr))
D=pd.DataFrame(detail)
print("=== hydrogen bonds to glutathione: fate of each in GDAP1 (structural equivalence) ===")
print(D.to_string(index=False))
T=D.groupby(['gene','cat']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\n",T.to_string())
C=pd.DataFrame(chg); print("\n=== formal charge of the 8 A glutathione shell, mapped positions only ===\n",C.to_string(index=False))
sc=D[D.cat.str.startswith('sidechain_')]
ret=(sc.cat=='sidechain_retained').sum(); lost=(sc.cat=='sidechain_lost').sum(); unm=(sc.cat=='sidechain_unmapped').sum()
bb=(D.cat=='backbone_retained').sum(); bbu=(D.cat=='backbone_unmapped').sum()
print(f"\nTotals over 4 GSH complexes: backbone H-bonds retained {bb}, backbone unmapped {bbu}; "
      f"side-chain retained {ret}, lost {lost}, unmapped {unm}")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
cats=['backbone_retained','sidechain_retained','sidechain_lost','backbone_unmapped','sidechain_unmapped']
cols=['#2a6ebb','#5fa8d3','#d7263d','#9bb7cc','#f0a6a6']
bot=np.zeros(len(T))
for c,col in zip(cats,cols):
    v=T[c].values if c in T else np.zeros(len(T))
    ax[0].bar(T.index,v,bottom=bot,label=c.replace('_',' '),color=col); bot+=v
ax[0].set_ylabel('hydrogen bonds to glutathione (<= 3.5 A)')
ax[0].set_title('Fate of each GSH hydrogen bond at the\nstructurally equivalent GDAP1 position')
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5)
x=np.arange(len(C)); w=0.38
ax[1].bar(x-w/2,C.ref_charge,w,label='reference GST',color='#2a6ebb')
ax[1].bar(x+w/2,C.gdap1_charge,w,label='GDAP1 equivalent',color='#d7263d')
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(C.gene); ax[1].axhline(0,color='k',lw=0.8)
ax[1].set_ylabel('net formal charge of the 8 A G-site shell')
ax[1].set_title('Charge of the glutathione pocket shell\n(same mapped positions in both proteins)')
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
